source: Every validation of the six ioctls in kernel/ at driver HEAD, one case per condition
criteria: The ioctl returns the named errno and nothing is published (no job, no mapping, BO bytes unchanged)

parameters.condition: the ioctl argument does not point at a readable (in) or writable (out) struct poulsback_bo_create
parameters.note: DRM layer, before and after the handler. A readable but read-only struct fails only on the copy back, after the handler's side effect.
psb_pci_remove calls drm_dev_unplug (linux.patch). A caller with the fd open needs root to provoke it (sysfs PCI remove).
bo-stress's 'c.flags = 2' predates SCANOUT. 2 is SCANOUT now, so it tests bo-create/scanout-without-cpu-wc. No client sets an unknown bit such as 4.

Host test asserts the helper's status, not the ioctl's errno (the mapping is untested). bo-stress's 'c.bo_class = 5' is stale: class 5 is PARAMETER, a valid class, so that create now succeeds and the CHECK fails. No client uses class 6.

parameters.condition: poulsback_engine_get fails: the engine is wedged (e->error) or its bring-up fails
parameters.note: A caller provokes it with a job that times out (ETIMEDOUT) or faults (EIO). Nothing resets, so every later create in the boot fails. Bring-up returns ENODEV when the SGX is not in probe state, and EBUSY when PM or removal closed the SGX source. The handler's '!exec || !vm' ENODEV is unreachable.

parameters.condition: poulsback_engine_get fails (engine wedged, or bring-up failed or blocked)
parameters.note: See context-create/engine-unavailable. A caller wedges the engine with a hanging or faulting job, and every later SUBMIT in the boot fails.

parameters.condition: on the context's first SUBMIT, scene_create returns NULL
parameters.note: A caller can provoke it without memory pressure. Destroy a context while its job is still running or not yet freed, then create a new one: the idr reuses the lowest handle, the old scene still reserves that 1 MiB scene slot, and poulsback_vm_map_fixed fails (drm_mm_reserve_node -ENOSPC). The ioctl reports -ENOMEM. A held job keeps the slot for good.
